subject: general
question: Two trains are running in opposite directions at speeds of 72 km/hr and 108 km/hr, respectively. The length of the first train is 150 m, and the length of the second train is 200 m. How much time will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ Relative speed = 72 + 108 = 180 km/hr

Convert to m/s ⇒ 180 × (5/18) = 50 m/s

Total length = 150 + 200 = 350 m

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 350 ÷ 50 = 7 sec

**∴ Answer = 7 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speeds = 72 km/hr and 108 km/hr

Lengths = 150 m and 200 m

**Formula used:**

Relative speed (opposite) = sum of speeds

Time = Total length ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 72 + 108 = 180 km/hr

⇒ Convert to m/s: 180 × (5/18) = 50 m/s

⇒ Total length = 150 + 200 = 350 m

⇒ Time = 350 ÷ 50 = 7 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 7 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ add speeds

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

Crossing Concept

Total distance = sum of lengths

Quick Tip

Always convert speed to same unit before dividing
